parole.testo: From Iranian Persian آبگوشت (âb-gušt), compound of آب (âb, “water”), and گوشت (gušt, “meat”).

parole.significato: Avestan language.
parole.testo: From Iranian Persian اوستا (avestâ), from Middle Persian [script needed] (ʾp(y)stʾk' /⁠abestāg⁠/), of uncertain meaning.
